en.headline: HKDI exhibition shows rare Leslie Cheung photos until mid-November
en.dek: The free display at the Hong Kong Design Institute in Tseung Kwan O features previously unpublished archival images from the 1980s and 1990s, a concert microphone stand and student works, with advance online registration required.
body: The Hong Kong Design Institute and the Hong Kong Institute of Professional Photographers are presenting the Leslie・Grace at 70 Exhibition, a free public showcase of the late Cantopop singer and actor Leslie Cheung.

The exhibition, which runs until 15 November, includes a collection of previously unpublished archival photographs, film negatives and Polaroids from the 1980s and 1990s, together with the silver microphone stand used at Cheung’s Final Encounter of the Legend farewell concert.

It is divided into thematic zones and also features a darkroom installation and contemporary projects by more than 400 design students. A limited-edition commemorative vinyl produced with Universal Music Hong Kong is available at the venue shop.
Entry is free but advance online registration is required. The exhibition is open daily from 10am to 7pm at the Hong Kong Design Institute, 3 King Ling Road, Tseung Kwan O.

zh.headline: 知專設計學院張國榮紀念展展出至11月中 免費參觀
zh.dek: 將軍澳展覽包括多幅八九十年代未公開照片、演唱會銀色咪架及逾400名學生作品，需預先網上預約。
body: 香港知專設計學院與香港專業攝影師公會合辦「風華70 • 設計共鳴 哥哥紀念展」，免費向公眾展出已故流行歌手及演員張國榮的相關資料。
展覽至11月15日止，包括多幅1980至1990年代拍攝、首次公開的檔案照片、菲林負片及寶麗來，以及張國榮「最終的告別」演唱會所用的銀色咪架。
展覽分為主題區域，並設有暗房裝置及逾400名設計學生的當代創作項目。場內商店亦有與環球音樂香港合作製作的限量紀念黑膠唱片。
入場免費，但須預先網上預約。展覽每日上午10時至晚上7時開放，地點為將軍澳景嶺路3號香港知專設計學院。
